purpose: Test whether StegVerse can preserve governed mathematical continuity while replacing repeated full-artifact prompt replay with hashed artifact references, a compact accepted-state ledger, and stage-specific selective retrieval.

success_criteria.continuity: Compact lane reaches the same highest admitted stage as the corresponding full-context lane.
success_criteria.cost: Compact lane uses fewer canonical input tokens and lower observed provider cost.
success_criteria.integrity: All full artifacts, hashes, validation decisions, and ledger entries remain reconstructable.
success_criteria.claim_boundary: This tests governed context compression and selective retrieval. It does not establish independent theorem discovery by StegVerse.
